Class ModelMemo<K,V>

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client.render.resolver.ModelMemo<K,V>
Type Parameters:
K - the model type keyed on (EntityModel, or GeckoLib's BakedGeoModel)
V - the resolved value (Attachment, or a GeckoLib bone)
public final class ModelMemo<K,V> extends Object
Memoizes a value per (model instance, attach token), misses included. An entry stays valid for as long as its model lives, so a datapack reload never clears anything here; clear() drops every entry when models are replaced, which is also the only way an entry goes. Models are matched by identity: the cached values are parts of that very instance, and GeckoLib's baked models are records that compare equal to any model of the same structure, including the one a resource reload replaces.

Client main thread only.
